how: We read the website of every Las Vegas wedding photographer listed on Lazo (82 listings, 68 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: headshot and portrait studios, photo booth companies, on-demand booking platforms, out-of-state photographers with a Las Vegas page, and one photo-video outfit listed ten times under different names. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Do you shoot Strip chapels and desert sites like Red Rock or Valley of Fire regularly, and do you know the permit and timing rules at each?
How many edited images per hour, how fast do they arrive, and do I get print rights?
For a midday summer ceremony, how do you handle harsh light, and will you scout the location first?

picks.name: Tiago Pinheiro Photography
picks.blurb: Tiago Pinheiro shoots Las Vegas weddings and elopements on digital and 35mm film with a candid, relaxed approach. A self-described nerdy kid who got into photography in 2011 by helping with his then-wife's gear, he publishes elopement collections for couples who want their day documented naturally.

picks.name: Carrie Pollard Photography
picks.blurb: Carrie Pollard specializes in Las Vegas elopements and intimate weddings with a style she calls fun, vibrant and punchy. Originally from a small California town, she has called Las Vegas home for nine years, offers planning help before the day, and will travel.

picks.name: John Bognot Photography
picks.blurb: A Filipino-American wedding and elopement photographer who spent years as an ICU nurse before picking up the camera. John Bognot shoots adventure-loving couples in Las Vegas and at destinations worldwide, with an eye for the in-between moments.

picks.name: Chasing Chickadees Photography
picks.blurb: Alicia Arcidiacono of Chasing Chickadees describes weddings as her jam, staying involved from planning through the day so couples can sit back and enjoy it. Based in Boulder City, she shoots weddings, events and destination work in a vibrant, joyous style.

picks.name: Taylor Made Photography
picks.blurb: Heather Taylor has spent more than ten years photographing engagements, elopements and intimate weddings in Las Vegas. Her pricing page promises no gatekeeping and no inquire-for-pricing mystery, which is rare enough here to be worth noting.

picks.name: Jean Phillips Photography
picks.blurb: Jean Phillips relocated to Las Vegas in 2005 when her husband was stationed at Nellis AFB and has photographed weddings, events and families here since. Collections are pitched as affordable and each includes a personal wedding website and a photography timeline.

picks.name: Eugene Kim Photography
picks.blurb: Eugene Kim runs a small team of three photographers split between San Francisco and Las Vegas, with more than a thousand couples behind them. Cinematic photography and film from one artist, help with planning, and a pricing page built to be simple.

picks.name: Ivan & Diana Photography
picks.blurb: Ivan photographs Vegas elopements and weddings at spots like Sure Thing Chapel and the Neon Museum, and promises a minimum of 70 edited full-resolution files per hour with the right to print and post. When he is not shooting he is hiking Red Rock or camping in Utah.

picks.name: JamieY Photography
picks.blurb: Jamie Y is drawn to people who live a little differently, and has photographed couples, elopements and weddings for over a decade with a steady, intentional approach. Warm, moody and earthy images, with direction when you need it and none when you do not.

picks.name: Pablo Zanardi Wedding and Elopement Photo Video
picks.blurb: Pablo Zanardi has photographed and filmed hundreds of couples since 2018, mixing digital, 35mm film, Polaroids and Super 8 to suit each wedding. Originally from Brazil, Las Vegas has been home for almost ten years, and the work carries a music-inspired edge.

picks.name: Tree of Life Films & Photos
picks.blurb: Tree of Life is a married duo doing elopement photography and video for what they call adventure-ish couples, in Las Vegas, California, Utah, Arizona and beyond. They got into the business after receiving their own wedding film and photos and wanting to make something that felt like the couple.

picks.name: Keith Kaplan Photography
picks.blurb: Keith Kaplan is the home of the $395 two-hour Strip wedding photography tour with transportation included, and offers a Get Married With Elvis package. The pitch is affordable professional photography, with an hour of video available as a $200 add-on.
